notes: Lightweight eval set. Triggering cases guard against mis-routing among the many video skills; functional cases assert the ship contract. Run with-skill vs baseline and compare (see the guide's Testing chapter).

should_trigger: edit this [raw webcam + screen recording attached]
turn this raw footage into a finished YouTube video with shorts
cut this recording down and give me the long + a few shorts
should_not_trigger: add captions to this already-edited video (→ embedded-captions)
make a faceless explainer about X (→ faceless-explainer)
make a 10s animated stat callout (→ motion-graphics)
write me a thread about this topic (→ viral-writer)

functional.name: dual-source one-shot
functional.given: a raw webcam.mp4 + screen.mp4 in a folder, ~12 min raw with retakes and long gaps
expect: final long is 16:9 1080p and plays end-to-end
webcam PiP present bottom-right with rounded corners; screen recording rounded
karaoke is clean (one cue at a time), synced to speech
karaoke preserves sentence-ending periods, question marks, and exclamation marks
all >0.2s word gaps tightened to ~0.1s; sacred pauses preserved
no repeated-phrase pair remains (retakes removed, last take kept)
Descript Studio Sound applied; duration parity and Effect-Survival Gate pass
one ranked primary long plus two complete alternate-hook longs share one identical body
frame one moves; money shot by 3s, real proof by 10s, stakes by 30s
three HyperFrames opening compositions use at least three semantic layout states
one hash-identical HyperFrames body composition is reused across all three longs
opening ranking auto-selects only with a certain lead greater than five points
frame contract, animation maps, provenance, selection receipt, and 0/1/3/10/30 comparison frames exist
3-5 Shorts rendered, each a standalone moment with its own hook + karaoke
every unique beat from edit-plan.md survives (no gutting)
spot-check.md lists any uncertain cuts
no titles, descriptions, chapters, thumbnails, uploads, or publishing are produced

functional.name: talking-head only
expect: auto-detects talking-head layout (no PiP)
still produces long + shorts + clean karaoke + Studio Sound

functional.name: no-gutting guard
functional.given: a 70-min recording that is mostly dead air + retakes around ~10 min of real content
expect: final ~10 min (dead weight removed) — NOT gutted to seconds
every distinct substantive beat retained
